from pathlib import Path
import subprocess,sys,json
base=Path(__file__).resolve().parent;root=base.parent.parent;source='/dev/shm/gef-resident-resources-20261112/source'
kind,cpus,timeout=sys.argv[1:];name='resident-resources-'+kind
command=['systemd-run','--user','--unit='+name,'--service-type=exec','--slice=background.slice','--working-directory='+source,'--property=KillMode=control-group','--property=RuntimeMaxSec='+timeout,'--property=TimeoutStopSec=30','--property=Nice=10','--property=CPUAffinity='+cpus.replace('-', ' - '),'--property=MemoryMax=256G','/usr/bin/taskset','-c',cpus,'/usr/bin/python3',source+'/scripts/job.py','--output-dir',str(root/'artifacts/jobs'/name),'--','/bin/bash',str(base/(kind+'.sh'))]
# taskset supplies the actual inherited process mask; AllowedCPUs alone did not on this host.
command=[arg for arg in command if not arg.startswith('--property=CPUAffinity=')]
subprocess.run(command,check=True)
subprocess.run(['systemctl','--user','show',name,'-p','MainPID','-p','Slice','-p','ControlGroup','-p','ActiveState'],check=True)
